title: A Universal Obstruction to the Samuelson Condition for Tangent Lagrangian 2-Webs
summary: We study the Samuelson area condition for Lagrangian \(2\)-webs in the symplectic plane generated by tangent lines to plane curves. We prove that, near every point of nonzero curvature of a \(C^\infty\) regular plane curve, the local tangent \(2\)-web formed by nearby distinct tangent lines is not a Samuelson web. The obstruction comes from a universal local phenomenon: the Jacobian of the intersection map of two tangent lines has a simple zero along the diagonal where the two lines coalesce, producing a logarithmic singularity and hence a nonzero mixed derivative.
